path.description: Output-only, derived from contentHash as `blobs/sha256/<contentHash>`. A caller-supplied value that disagrees with the derived path is refused (design D8).

contentSchemaId.description: A schema identifier that embeds a version, e.g. `heniek://contract/<Name>/v<N>` — this is how the ref preserves the content's schema version. Pattern-constrained so a non-version-bearing id is rejected by construction.

producer.description: Opaque identity of the worker/profile that produced the artifact (an engine, profile or tool identity, e.g. `heniek-cli@0.0.0`) — not a run or stage id.

sourceLineage.description: Bounded so a single ref has a computable maximum size under the event-payload cap.
